Package com.recruitment.service

Class UserService

java.lang.Object
com.recruitment.service.UserService
public class UserService extends Object
Service layer for user account management.

Handles authentication, registration, profile updates, role-based lookup, keyword search, and deletion. Passwords are stored using PasswordUtil hashing; legacy plaintext passwords are migrated automatically on load and login.

Data is persisted in data/users.json via JsonUtil. An in-memory list is loaded at construction and written back on each mutating operation. When the store is empty, default demo users (admin, MOs, TAs) are seeded.

  • Method Details

    • reload

      public void reload()
      Reloads user data from the JSON file, discarding unsaved in-memory changes. Re-runs password migration and default-user seeding when applicable.

    • authenticate

      public User authenticate(String username, String password)
      Authenticates a user by username and password.

      On successful login, legacy plaintext passwords are upgraded to a hash and saved.

      Parameters:
      username - the login username (case-sensitive match)
      password - the plain-text password to verify
      Returns:
      the matching User if credentials are valid; null if not found or password mismatch

    • register

      public boolean register(User user)
      Registers a new user if the username is not already taken.

      Assigns a new USR- prefixed ID and hashes the password before persistence.

      Parameters:
      user - the user to register; must have a unique User.getUsername()
      Returns:
      true if registration succeeded; false if the username already exists

    • updateUser

      public boolean updateUser(User user)
      Updates an existing user by matching on User.getId().
      Parameters:
      user - the user record with updated fields; ID must match an existing entry
      Returns:
      true if the user was found and updated; false if no matching ID exists

    • searchUsers

      public List<User> searchUsers(String keyword)
      Searches users by keyword across username, name, email, department, and role name.

      Matching is case-insensitive and uses substring containment. A null or blank keyword returns all users.

      Parameters:
      keyword - the search term; may be null
      Returns:
      a filtered list of matching users (never null)

    • getAllUsers

      public List<User> getAllUsers()
      Returns the live in-memory list of all users.

      Callers should treat the returned list as the service's working copy; mutating it without going through service methods may bypass persistence.

      Returns:
      the internal list of all users (never null)
